name: 32344 · Monticello, FL
findings: ZIP 32344 (Monticello) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32344 (Monticello) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32344 (Monticello) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
